args.question: Cobalt Labs (V-186) has TWO approved invoices: INV-30444 for $3,714.45 (due 2026-11-04) and INV-51862 for $6,764.82 (due 2026-11-25). You asked me to pay "the approved invoice" (one). Which one should I wire? Or should I pay both?

trace.question: Cobalt Labs (V-186) has TWO approved invoices: INV-30444 for $3,714.45 (due 2026-11-04) and INV-51862 for $6,764.82 (due 2026-11-25). You asked me to pay "the approved invoice" (one). Which one should I wire? Or should I pay both?

trace.message: Pay INV-51862, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid Cobalt Labs invoice **INV-51862** by wire from the operating account. The payment was made once and has been confirmed.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Amount:** $6,764.82 (the full invoice)
- **Status:** Sent

**Why this invoice:** Cobalt Labs had two approved invoices, so I asked you which one to pay. You chose INV-51862 (due 2026-11-25). I didn't pay INV-30444 ($3,714.45) because you said it's under dispute.

**Making sure it went once:** No payments had gone out from the operating account before this one. I also sent the wire with a unique request key, so a retry can't pay it twice.

The amount is under $10,000, so it didn't need controller approval.
